display_long_description:
HoloMedicine® Education brings medical imaging data into mixed reality for learning, training, and exploration. Designed for medical students, residents, educators, surgical trainees, allied health learners, and anyone studying human anatomy in 3D.

# FEATURES

- DICOM visualization (CT, MR, PET, SPECT, US, XA) with multiplanar reconstruction — axial, coronal, sagittal
- Interactive 3D anatomical models and 2D media (images, videos, PDFs)
- Crop, rotate, and window/level adjustments (CT presets: Bone, Lung, Soft Tissue, Liver, Brain)
- Planning tools — annotate, place arrows and markers in 3D space; save and load scenarios

- Hand-tracking only; no controllers required
- Sample educational datasets pre-loaded — start exploring immediately, no login needed
- Collaboration (Coming Soon) — host or join collaborative sessions with peers and instructors

# REQUIREMENTS
Meta Quest 3 or Quest 3S, Horizon OS v83.0+, Wi-Fi (min 30 Mbps for Shared Experience). HoloMedicine® account for access to your organization's content library.

# ⚠ NOT A MEDICAL DEVICE
HoloMedicine® Education is provided for education and training purposes only. 

It is NOT intended for clinical use, medical diagnosis, treatment decisions, surgical planning for real patients, or any patient-care workflow.
 

Produced by apoQlar GmbH, Hamburg, Germany.
